key_insight: A hardware-native non-Abelian mixer for hybrid oscillator-qubit QAOA improves Max-Cut performance over the standard transverse-field mixer in simulations.
engineering_relevance: This work points to a practical control primitive for designing more effective QAOA circuits on emerging hybrid CV-DV quantum processors.
method: Propose a non-Abelian mixer tailored to hybrid oscillator-qubit hardware.
Build a hybrid QAOA ansatz for the Max-Cut problem.
Benchmark against the transverse-field mixer using approximation ratio and optimal-solution probability.
evidence_signal: In simulations on unweighted Erdős-Rényi graphs, across all tested graph sizes and Fock cutoffs, the proposed mixer consistently outperformed the transverse-field baseline on both expected solution quality and probability of sampling an optimal solution.
watch_item: Results are simulation-based and depend on Fock cutoff choices, so hardware noise and finite-level truncation effects still need experimental validation.
paper_title: Non-Abelian Mixer for QAOA on Hybrid Oscillator-Qubit Quantum Processors
